what_she_is: Cosmetic chemist, PhD. Writes Lab Muffin Beauty Science.
why_this_creator: Chosen as a real-world match for Maya: sceptical of hype, heavy on sunscreen, writes to talk people OUT of things. Science-led rather than price-led, so she should diverge from Maya on price - which is the interesting part.
cleaning_note: Repeated site boilerplate (affiliate disclosure, citation block, nav, footer) stripped before extraction. Her actual prose is untouched. Each post is then capped at its first 3000 characters, cut at a sentence end: 57,015 chars -> 29,137. The cap was measured, not guessed: re-extracted live at 3,000 all fourteen slots come back at the same LEVEL as the full 57,015-character corpus, and the extraction costs 16,473 input tokens instead of 22,832. At 1,500 `price_refusal` crossed 0.5 and changed level, so 1,500 was rejected. Four-run table in MAX_CHARS_PER_ITEM, scripts/fetch_corpus.py.
vision_note: The images are read by gpt-4o-mini under a strict json_schema, not by Jev. Jev judges the extracted attributes. The pictures are Michelle Wong's own, published on the site they were fetched from; we reference the original URL and do not re-host them. An image we could not read carries vision: null and an error, never a guess.
text_policy: PUBLICATION EXCERPT. Michelle Wong wrote these posts. They are hers, not ours. This repository is public, so each body is cut to roughly its first 200 characters. Titles, URLs, dates, image URLs and the typed vision attributes are unchanged. The extraction frozen in cache/extract-labmuffin.json was computed against the full 57015-character corpus described by cleaning_note below. To reproduce it you must re-fetch her text yourself: `python scripts/fetch_corpus.py rss https://labmuffin.com/feed/ --full`, then `python scripts/enrich_images.py labmuffin`.
rights: Text copyright Michelle Wong, labmuffin.com. Excerpted here for reference and not relicensed. Her photographs are referenced at their original URLs. No image bytes are stored in this repository.
excerpt_note: Her words, verbatim, but truncated to ~200 characters per post. Excerpting does not make it paraphrase - every character here is hers. The full bodies are her copyright and not ours to redistribute; re-fetch with scripts/fetch_corpus.py rss https://labmuffin.com/feed/ --full
